blind.why: Alley with viewmodel (ours: v_long, seed 4, HUD off; ref ss_4 Inferno). The ref is airy: shaded walls are light and full of detail. Ours is warm and cohesive but underexposed. The shaded facades are brown mud, the corners are crushed by vignette and the sky is a dull grey-blue.

Shaded archway passage (ours: h_a-door; ref ss_8). In the ref the shade glows with bounce light (floor about 67,56,50) and every cast shadow reads. In ours the shaded floor is about 32,31,29, the left third goes almost black and lit vs shade is about 4.5x, so shade becomes a void.

Sunny plaza (ours: v_b-site; ref ss_7). Ours reads as dusk: an orange-brown monochrome floor, dark murky buildings against a desaturated sky and a heavy dark frame. The ref is bright midday with a varied palette.

Tunnel (ours: v_tunnel-bend; ref ss_9). The lamp pools and ceiling depth in ours are atmospheric, a real improvement. But the left half (wall, doorway, crate) crushes to black (21% of pixels below L 0.06), so a player could not read anything hiding there.

biggest_gap: Global exposure and shade fill are far too low, so the whole game reads as dusk or overcast and shadowed areas crush. Measured on 11 HUD-off gameplay frames vs 8 CS2 frames: median luminance 0.19 vs 0.40, p5 0.06 vs 0.17, pixels below L 0.06 11.1% vs 0.4%, corner/centre luminance 0.32 vs 1.03. Reproduce: ?test=1&seed=3&match=1&phase=live, place at tide-spawn (0,0,-39) looking -Z with HUD hidden. The open-air spawn courtyard is in the sun-facing-away shadow, flat grey (wall 61,63,59; floor 30,33,35) and looks like night. a-door shaded floor is 32,31,29. Fix: raise the open-air shade floor about 2x (sky/env ambient plus a warm sun-bounce fill on surfaces facing away from the sun; keep skyOcc darkening only for truly roofed spaces). Lift the toe of the tone curve or raise exposure about 0.85 to 1.0. Cut the vignette by half. Target CS2 values: sunlit-to-shade about 2-3x, shade around 60-70 sRGB on floors and 120+ on walls.
other_gaps: Vignette and dark frame are too heavy. vignette 0.2 plus darkness makes the corners 0.2-0.4x the centre (CS2 is about 1.0). With vignette off, crushed pixels at b-site drop from 7.6% to 4.9%.
The sky reads dusky and grey-blue at the horizon (a-ramp, b-site, tide-spawn), not a bright midday Mediterranean sky. Behind sunlit buildings it gives no clean value separation.
SSAO is effectively invisible. Toggling 'ssao' changes 0.13% of pixels by more than 20 levels at long and b-site, so props have little contact grounding beyond the vertex AO.
Ground materials are flat colour at gameplay range: large sand and tile areas with no breakup, roughness or specular variation (long, b-site floors).
Distant facades in shade (a-ramp background, b-site tower) go to dark low-contrast brown with no aerial perspective lift. Depth layering is weak.
The damage screen effect tints the whole screen warm instead of a directional edge pulse. It is readable but less directional than CS2's hit indicator.
strengths: Round-1 biggest gap is fixed: shade is now warm and neutral, not cobalt, and roofed spaces are darker and warmer, with lamp pools in the B tunnel and the occluded mid-doors arch
Team suits (emissive tide cyan, ember orange) read well in sun, in shade and in the dark tunnel at 8-20 m
Crisp, stable sun shadows. The sun-facing view has a pleasant glow and bloom without blowout

Zero console errors across 4 match sessions, 25+ positions, fx and a quality switch. About 80-120 draw calls, about 190k tris, 12 post passes. The low preset (scale 0.85, 1024 shadows) still looks coherent
Cohesive warm palette with good accent colours (teal tiles, awnings, signage)
